$comment: PROPOSAL, filed by track C (unit c-09) to track A as A-C11. NOT PART OF THE CONTRACT. A patch to the `coverage` kind (A-C7; adopted on branch a-05-coverage-predictor-kinds, not yet on main). Apply: add `properties.status` below to $defs.SportCoverage.properties, append "status" to $defs.SportCoverage.required, add $defs.SportStatus verbatim, then delete this file in the same commit. tests/test_export_coverage.py applies THIS FILE to whichever schema the producer validates against, so the diff filed and the diff tested are one text; it fails once the schema carries `status` while this file still exists. jobs/export_coverage.py emits `status` only when the schema admits it.

SportStatus.description: What has been DECIDED about this sport, which the holdings cannot say: a null holding reads identically whether the sport was set aside on purpose or never reached. `carried`: worked; its holdings say how far that has got, and may still be null. `held`: decided against for now - `since` and `reason` are required, and `revisit` says what would reopen it without promising that anything will. `not_attempted`: no decision either way; `since` and `reason` are null, and the producer refuses a not_attempted sport whose holdings are not all null. A page for a held sport must not say the sport is coming. Declared by the producer, never read from data, and it carries no figures.
